the presence of BCP mutation in HBeAg-negative patients is associated with more advanced fibrosis, higher risk of cirrhosis and HCC and more severe liver disease [9][10][11][12][13][14].

the presence of PC/BCP mutations is an independent predictor of HCC and liver-related death.
the presence of drug resistance mutations in HBeAg-positive and HBeAg-negative HBV strains does not affect the replicative capacity of the virus in vitro.
